# Security policy

## Supported version

Version `0.1.x` is a reference implementation, not a production-approved service. Security fixes target the current `main` branch. There is no production deployment or long-term support promise yet.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use a [private GitHub security advisory](https://github.com/starSumi/sumi-agentic-voice-crm/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue and do not include real credentials, customer data, audio, transcripts, or production connection strings.

Include the affected commit, boundary, minimal reproduction, impact, and any known containment. The maintainer will acknowledge the report, validate it against the current source, and coordinate a fix and disclosure. No response-time SLA is promised for this reference release.
